inspiration.observed_pattern: A SQL string-length corpus compares character-length behavior for multibyte, supplementary-plane, combining-mark, and ordinary text values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored text-storage audit. CHARACTER_LENGTH counts logical characters while LENGTH reports encoded byte length for fixed Unicode samples, including empty and NULL values; unsupported source-specific code-unit arguments and source literals are not copied.

fixture_notes: Samples 501-503 distinguish logical character counts from byte counts for multibyte and combining-mark text; sample 504 is empty and sample 505 is NULL.
determinism_notes: All sample IDs, labels, Unicode literals, and ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE text_samples (sample_id INT PRIMARY KEY, sample_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, sample_text VARCHAR(64) NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT sample_id, sample_label, CHARACTER_LENGTH(sample_text) AS character_count, LENGTH(sample_text) AS byte_count FROM text_samples ORDER BY sample_id

checks.sql: SELECT sample_id, sample_text FROM text_samples ORDER BY sample_id
